description: This script manages and processes authentication directories and files for the openclaw Docker environment. It provides functions to normalize, include, collect, and join authentication-related data based on provided input or overrides.

methods.name: openclaw_live_trim
methods.description: Trims leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

methods.name: openclaw_live_normalize_auth_dir
methods.description: Normalizes an authentication directory path based on input, removing leading dots and ensuring a consistent format.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_dir_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the auth directory to include based on the provider name.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_file_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the auth file to include based on the provider name.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_csv
methods.description: Collects authentication directories from a CSV string of providers.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_override
methods.description: Collects authentication directories based on override variables or defaults.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs
methods.description: Collects authentication directories either from override or defaults.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_csv
methods.description: Collects authentication files from a CSV string of providers.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_override
methods.description: Collects authentication files based on override variables or defaults.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files
methods.description: Collects authentication files either from override or defaults.

methods.name: openclaw_live_join_csv
methods.description: Joins multiple string values into a single CSV string.
